Container testing must be a self-contained carbon copy venv - never read/write to local opencode config. Test runner must run entirely inside container with container's own opencode.json. Built files get installed into CONTAINER's opencode config, not local.

OPENCODE CONTAINER: Use 'opencode container run -- <command>' or 'opencode container start' for interactive. DO NOT use standalone node run-tests.js or static grep analysis. Container tests must spawn actual opencode process.

PLUGIN BUILD: Always preserve source structure. Plugin directories must have src/, dist/, package.json. Build to separate directory then copy - never build directly to plugin dir or source gets overwritten with only bundle.

OPENCODE.JSON PLUGIN PATHS: Must point to actual .js files, not directories. Use 'file:///path/to/plugin/dist/index.js' not 'file:///path/to/plugin'. Directory paths break because opencode looks for dist/index.js inside but structure may not be preserved.

SHIP GATE MANDATORY: Delivery gate requires ContainerTestResult.json with 96%+ pass rate from actual opencode container run. Static analysis (grep, cat) does NOT count. Evidence must show real opencode process spawned, not standalone test runner.
